name: predicates
expr: s1 = double(issymmetric(SY)); s2 = double(issymmetric(H)); s3 = double(issymmetric(SK,'skew')); h1 = double(ishermitian(H)); h2 = double(ishermitian(SY)); h3 = double(ishermitian([0 1i; 1i 0],'skew')); ib1 = double(isbanded(D,0,0)); ib2 = double(isbanded(A,1,1)); ib3 = double(isbanded(A,0,1)); id1 = double(isdiag(D)); id2 = double(isdiag(A)); itl = double(istril(L)); itu = double(istriu(U)); itlA = double(istril(A)); ituA = double(istriu(A)); [bl, bu] = bandwidth(A); blU = bandwidth(U); blL = bandwidth(L); buU = bandwidth(U,'upper'); blU2 = bandwidth(U,'lower'); v1 = vecnorm([3 4]); v2 = vecnorm([3;4]); v3c = vecnorm(V); v4 = vecnorm(r,1); v5 = vecnorm(r,Inf); v6r = vecnorm([1 2; 3 4],2,2); ve = vecnorm([]);
comment: MATLAB linalg predicates batch: issymmetric/ishermitian (with optional 'skew'), isbanded(A,lo,up), isdiag, istril, istriu, bandwidth (1-out=lower / 2-out=[lo,up] / 'lower'|'upper' opt), vecnorm(A[,p[,dim]]). All comparisons exact (== 0). Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b: predicates produce 0/1, bandwidth produces integers, vecnorm produces doubles. Empty vecnorm([]) -> scalar 0 (MATLAB convention). issymmetric/ishermitian use exact transpose/conj-transpose without tolerance. Octave 11.1.0 ships isbanded/isdiag/issymmetric/ishermitian/istril/istriu but not bandwidth/vecnorm.
